title: Cyprus foreign minister to visit PH, sign deals on seafarers, sports

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cyprus’ Foreign Minister Constantinos Kombos will make the first-ever visit by a Cypriot foreign minister to the Philippines on Oct. 7, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said Monday. During his visit to the country, Manila and Nicosia are expected to sign agreements covering sports cooperation and the recognition of certificates issued to Filipino seafarers. Kombos will meet with his Philippine counterpart, Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro, for bilateral talks on “political and economic cooperation, maritime engagements, people-to-people exchanges and consular concerns, as well as regional and global issues of mutual interest,” the DFA said.
